summary.text: Rita Mendes is a Democratic state representative from the 11th Plymouth District who has held the seat since January 4, 2023 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. She is an attorney and real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Rita Mendes earned a J.D. from New England Law | Boston in 2017, and her career experience includes working as an attorney and a real estate broker.
She succeeded Claire Cronin in the 11th Plymouth District seat in 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session her committee assignments include House Ways and Means, Judiciary, and the Election Laws Joint Committee, on which she is vice chair.
